name: Job Requisition-custom_branch
label: Branch
description: The branch the position is for. Its Supervisor, HOD, HR Officer and General Manager approve the requisition; the HR Manager and Executive Director serve every branch.

name: Job Requisition-custom_position_category
label: Position Category
description: From the Department. Administrative: HR Manager, then Executive Director. Non-Administrative: HR Manager, the branch General Manager, then Executive Director.

name: Job Requisition-custom_employment_type
label: Permanent or Casual
description: The form tick-box: Permanent or Casual(s). Copied to the Job Opening Employment Type.

name: Job Requisition-custom_reason_type
label: Reason Why New Employee Is Required

name: Job Requisition-custom_reporting_line
label: Reporting Line of the New Employee

name: Job Requisition-custom_department_signoff_section
label: Requesting Department
description: Filled in automatically as each approver acts in the Job Requisition Approval workflow.

name: Job Requisition-custom_hrm_decision
label: HR Manager Decision
description: The Recommended Salary is on the Details tab.

name: Job Requisition-custom_gm_signoff_section
label: General Manager
description: Non-administrative departments only: the branch's General Manager, after the HR Manager.

name: Job Opening-custom_reason_type
label: Reason Why New Employee Is Required

name: Job Opening-custom_reporting_line
label: Reporting Line of the New Employee

name: Job Opening-custom_show_job_description
label: Show Job Description on Careers Page
description: Adds the Job Title's purpose, responsibilities, requirements and competencies to this job's page. KRA weightings, reporting lines and other internal parts are never shown.

name: Department-custom_position_category
label: Position Category
description: Routes the requisitions this department raises. Administrative: HR Manager, then Executive Director. Non-Administrative: HR Manager, the branch General Manager, then Executive Director.

name: Designation-custom_jd_date
label: JD Date
description: Period the JD applies from, e.g. Q2 2026.

name: Designation-custom_jd_reference
label: Reference
description: e.g. LPL/JD/SM/001

name: Designation-custom_jd_revision
label: Revision No
description: e.g. Rev 01

name: Designation-custom_jd_kra_section
label: Key Result Areas (Balanced Scorecard Framework)
description: Pick each KRA from the KRA list. Its Balanced Scorecard perspective comes from the KRA, and several KRAs can share one. Weightings across all rows must total 100%.

name: Designation-custom_jd_reporting_section
label: Reporting Relationships
description: One row per position that reports to this role, directly or indirectly.

name: Designation-custom_jd_authority_section
label: Decision-Making Authority / Mandates / Constraints
description: One row per decision area.

name: Designation-custom_jd_iso_section
label: ISO Responsibilities (ISO 9001, ISO 22000, ISO 45001, ISO 14001)
description: As part of the Integrated Management System (IMS), the role holder is accountable for:

name: Designation-custom_jd_iso_responsibilities
label: ISO Responsibilities
description: One row per standard.

name: Designation-custom_jd_specs_section
label: Ideal Job Specifications
description: One row per qualification, training or certification, or experience requirement.

name: Designation-custom_jd_competency_section
label: Competency Framework
description: One row per competency, picked from the Skill list.

name: Designation-custom_tools
label: Tools of Work
description: What a new employee with this Job Title is issued, besides the tools every new employee gets (Tool of Work: Every New Employee). The onboarding lists them.

name: KRA-custom_perspective
label: Balanced Scorecard Perspective
description: Groups this KRA on Job Descriptions. A KRA needs a perspective before a JD can use it.

name: Job Applicant-custom_branch
label: Branch
description: From the Job Opening applied for.

name: Job Applicant-custom_notice_period
label: Notice Period
description: e.g. One month

name: Job Applicant-custom_personal_section
label: Personal Information
description: From the Pre-Interview Bio-Data Form (LPL/HR/19). Carried onto the Employee record when the candidate is hired.

name: Job Applicant-custom_gender
label: Gender
description: Not on the paper form, but the Employee record requires it.

name: Job Applicant-custom_next_of_kin_section
label: Next of Kin Details
description: The first next of kin becomes the Employee's emergency contact.

name: Job Applicant-custom_school_results_section
label: A'Level and O'Level Results
description: One row per subject.

name: Job Applicant-custom_signed_bio_data
label: Signed Bio-Data Form
description: Scan of the form the candidate signed.

name: Employee-custom_residence_section
label: Home and Residence
description: From the Personal Bio-Data Form (LPL/HR/16). Print > Personal Bio-Data Form gives the form pre-filled, for the employee to check, complete and sign.

name: Employee-custom_bio_data_signed_on
label: Date Signed
description: The date on the signed form. The onboarding goes to the HR Manager only once it is recorded.

name: Employee-custom_signed_bio_data_form
label: Signed Personal Bio-Data Form
description: Scan of the form the employee signed.

name: Employee-custom_professional_section
label: Professional Certificates and Memberships
description: Certificates or qualifications obtained after formal education, and membership associations.

name: Employee-custom_probation_status
label: Probation Status
options:
On Probation
Extended
Confirmed
Not Confirmed
description: Set by the End of probation evaluation (Probation Evaluation).

name: Employee-custom_employee_tools
label: Tools of Work
description: Issued at onboarding (Employee Onboarding, Tools of Work) or since; Returned On at the clearance.

name: Job Offer-custom_branch
label: Branch
description: The candidate's branch, from the Job Opening. The onboarding takes it from here.

name: Employee Onboarding-custom_branch
label: Branch
description: The branch the new employee joins. Its HR Officer and Head of Department get the tasks.

name: Employee Onboarding-custom_onboarding_status
label: Onboarding Status
options:
Draft
Onboarding
Pending HR Manager Approval
Approved
Cancelled
description: Set by the Employee Onboarding workflow.

name: Employee Onboarding-custom_hr_officer
label: HR Officer
description: Runs the onboarding and gets the HR tasks. Defaults to the branch's HR Officer.

name: Employee Onboarding-custom_head_of_department
label: Head of Department
description: Receives the new employee (the handover) and gets the department's tasks. Defaults to the HOD who approved the requisition.

name: Employee Onboarding-custom_supervisor
label: Supervisor
description: The new employee reports to this Employee (Reports To, set when the HR Manager approves). Defaults to the Supervisor who signed the requisition.

name: Employee Onboarding-custom_orientation_section
label: Orientation
description: Step 2 of the induction, on the first day: print the Workplace Rules and Regulations (LPL/HR/05) from here (Print > Workplace Rules and Regulations) for the new employee to sign.

name: Employee Onboarding-custom_rules_signed_on
label: Workplace Rules Signed On
description: Needed before the onboarding goes to the HR Manager.

name: Employee Onboarding-custom_signed_workplace_rules
label: Signed Workplace Rules
description: Scan of the rules the new employee signed.

name: Employee Onboarding-custom_tools_section
label: Tools of Work
description: The tools every new employee gets and the Job Title's own (its Tools of Work tab). Each provider is asked for its tools when the onboarding starts; mark each one Issued, or Not Needed. The HR Manager checks them before approving; the issued ones go on the Employee's register.

name: Employee Onboarding-custom_salary_section
label: Salary
description: Becomes the Salary Structure Assignment: drafted when the onboarding goes to the HR Manager, submitted when approved.

name: Employee Onboarding-custom_salary_from
label: Effective From
description: Defaults to the Date of Joining.

name: Employee Onboarding-custom_income_tax_slab
label: Income Tax Slab
description: Needed when the Salary Structure deducts income tax.

name: Employee Onboarding-custom_base_salary
label: Base
description: Monthly, as in the appointment terms. Defaults to the requisition's Recommended Salary.

name: Employee Onboarding-custom_training_section
label: Training
description: If training is required: the trainer, scope and duration. The Training Event is made when the HR Manager approves, and the supervisor gets a task to evaluate it.

name: Employee Onboarding-custom_training_type
label: Type
options:
Workshop
Seminar
Theory
Conference
Exam
Internet
Self-Study

name: Employee Onboarding-custom_hrm_remarks
label: HR Manager's Remarks
description: What HR should change, when the HR Manager returns the onboarding. Update, then Return to HR.

name: Employment Type-custom_contract_months
label: Usual Contract Length (Months)
description: An Employee Contract of this type ends this many months after it starts. Blank or 0: open-ended (e.g. Permanent).

name: Interview Feedback-custom_evaluation_section
label: Candidate Interview Evaluation
description: Score each criterion: Excellent = 5 (90-100%), Very Good = 4 (75-89%), Good = 3 (60-74%), Average = 2 (50-59%), Below Average = 1 (49% and below), or N/A where it does not apply.

name: Interview Feedback-custom_max_score
label: Out Of
description: 5 for every criterion scored; N/A adds nothing.

name: Interview Feedback-custom_recommendation
label: Recommendation
description: Offer = selected, Shortlist = to be interviewed again, Reject = not selected.

name: Training Event-custom_branch
label: Branch
description: The plant the session is at; its HR Officer and Heads of Department are told.

name: Training Event-custom_department
label: Department
description: The department trained; its Head of Department confirms the participants.

name: Training Event-custom_schedule
label: Monthly Training Schedule
description: The schedule that booked this session.

name: Training Event-custom_shift
label: Shift
description: The shift trained, as the training memo says it.

name: Training Event-custom_memo_approved_by
label: Memo Approved By
description: The General Manager or Production Manager who signed off the training memo.

name: Training Event-custom_after_section
label: After the Session
description: Mark each participant Present or Absent, attach the signed attendance sheet (LPL/TRG/FRM03) and submit: the training was held. Then print the evaluation forms (LPL/TRG/FRM05), key each one in with Create Evaluations, and print the Training Evaluation Summary.

name: Training Event-custom_evaluation_score
label: Evaluation Score
description: The average of the participants' Section A ratings.

name: Training Feedback-custom_ratings_section
label: Section A: Items Assessed
description: Excellent, Very Good, Good, Average or Below Average for each item, as the participant ticked it.

name: Training Feedback-custom_score
label: Score
description: Excellent 5 down to Below Average 1, over what the items could score.

name: Training Feedback-custom_expectations
label: 1. Expectations at the beginning / what you wanted to learn

name: Training Feedback-custom_learnt
label: 2. New knowledge and skills learnt / acquired

name: Training Feedback-custom_application
label: 3. How you will apply it on the job / in your department

name: Training Feedback-custom_remaining_gaps
label: 4. Other training needs / gaps still challenging you

name: Training Feedback-custom_trainer_recommendations
label: 5. Recommendations for the trainers to improve

name: Training Feedback-custom_hr_recommendations
label: 6. Ways the HR office should improve in organising training

name: Training Feedback-custom_signed_on
label: Form Signed On
description: The date the participant signed the paper form.

label: Account Name
name: Employee-custom_bank_account_name
description: The name the account is held in, where it is not the employee's own.

label: Salary Remitted From
name: Employee-custom_salary_from_month
description: The month the employee instructed the salary to be paid to this account (LPL/HR/26).

label: Wages Phone Number
name: Employee-custom_wages_phone
description: The number the wages are sent to.

label: Registered Names
name: Employee-custom_wages_phone_names
description: The names the number is registered in, where they are not the employee's own.

label: Signed Bank Account Form
name: Employee-custom_signed_bank_form
description: LPL/HR/26, signed and witnessed.

label: Supervisor
name: Appraisal-custom_supervisor
description: Who rates the employee; taken from Reports To where it is blank.

label: Appraisal Status
name: Appraisal-custom_appraisal_status
options:
Draft
Pending Supervisor
Pending HR Manager
Pending Production Manager
Pending General Manager
Completed
Cancelled

label: Section A: Ratable Factors
name: Appraisal-custom_section_a
description: Rating scale: Excellent=5 (90-100%), Very Good=4 (75-89%), Good=3 (60-74%), Average=2 (50-59%), Below Average=1 (40% and below). Write N/A on a factor that does not fit the job.

label: Section B: Objectives / KPIs
name: Appraisal-custom_section_b
description: The objectives and KPIs for the period just ended, in line with the department's.

label: Year to Date
name: Appraisal-custom_annual_score
description: The average of the quarters appraised so far this year.

label: List down the roles and responsibilities of your position in the company
name: Appraisal-custom_roles

label: What are the skills you possess as a supervisor?
name: Appraisal-custom_skills

label: Can you share any achievements from the time you were appointed a supervisor?
name: Appraisal-custom_achievements

label: Can you share any challenges faced?
name: Appraisal-custom_challenges

label: Return Remarks
name: Appraisal-custom_return_remarks
description: Why the appraisal was sent back; clears every signature.

label: Outcome
name: Appraisal-custom_outcome
options:
Promotion
Salary Increase
Performance Improvement Plan
Close
description: What management decided on the Performance Review.

label: Form Type
name: Appraisal-custom_form_type
description: The supervisory form for supervisors; the balanced scorecard for graded roles.

label: Scorecard Template
name: Appraisal-custom_bsc_template
description: The role's scorecard. Get Scorecard fills Section A and B from it.

label: Period Being Scored
name: Appraisal-custom_period
description: Which column of the scorecard this round fills in.

label: Section A — Objectives & KPIs (80%)
name: Appraisal-custom_bsc_section_a
description: The weight is set once per perspective and the four total 80. Record the percentage achieved against target each quarter, and a score out of ten for the year.

label: KPIs
name: Appraisal-custom_bsc_kpis
description: What the percentage achieved is judged against.

label: Other Assignments / Special Tasks
name: Appraisal-custom_assignments_section
description: Recorded, not scored separately.
